			set_country_flag = wif_rko_first_raid

				50 = {

						limit = { OR = { state = 206 state = 204 state = 194 state = 94 state = 95 state = 96 state = 810 } NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_rko_depopulated } }
						save_event_target_as = terror_attack_state
					}
				}
				50 = { }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = terror_attack_state } }
				random_controlled_state = { limit = { OR = { state = 206 state = 204 state = 194 state = 94 state = 95 state = 96 state = 810 } } save_event_target_as = terror_attack_state }
			}
			event_target:terror_attack_state = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_belarusian_resistance days = 180 }
				set_state_flag = { flag = wif_terror_attack_target days = 90 value = 1 }
				set_state_flag = { flag = wif_terror_attack_window days = 45 value = 1 }
				wif_rko_raid_damage = yes
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = wif_rko.20.a
		random_list = {
			25 = { add_manpower = -2000 }
			25 = { add_manpower = -5000 }
			25 = { add_manpower = -7500 }
			25 = { add_manpower = -10000 }
		}
		hidden_effect = { wif_rko_schedule_raid = yes }
	}
